decisions.decision: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS Tic Tac Toe, no framework
decisions.why: The app is only a substrate for the agent loop. Extra build tooling would hide CI failures behind Vite config.

decisions.decision: MCP server reads live source instead of hardcoded answers
decisions.why: So 'what does the win check do?' stays correct after agents edit game.js.

decisions.decision: Linear is the ticket source of truth; local JSON is a fallback
decisions.why: The evaluation wants real Linear movement, but this workspace had no LINEAR_API_KEY at authoring time.

decisions.decision: Bootstrap opened four Tic Tac Toe tickets (rules, UI, persist, keyboard).
decisions.why: Keyboard is the leftover ticket so the loop has real work after the first agent pass.
